items.lede: Multiple family members can share data to help the agent make plans and complete tasks.
items.title: Google announces new experimental "CC" AI agent for families

items.lede: CC gives an AI agent its own Google account in your family or group and sends all members a daily briefing.
items.title: Google's revamped CC is an AI agent for families and groups

items.lede: Google is refocusing its CC AI agent on household coordination, letting families share emails, schedules, and tasks so the AI can manage calendars, fill out forms, make shopping lists, plan meals, and more.
items.title: Google’s new ‘CC’ is an AI agent that helps families run their households
